dslRule:
<!id: debug.enhanceAstIdentifier>
<!description: Adds the CompilationUnit's hash code to the identifier of the first type declaration for improved debug strings.>
<!severity: INFO>

$cu.types().get(0).getName().getIdentifier() :: instanceof($cu, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.dom.CompilationUnit")
=>
$cu.types().get(0).getName().getIdentifier() + "(" + $cu.hashCode() + ")"
;;
